annotations.title: Find emails waiting for your reply

description: Find conversations in ALL accounts (by default) where someone else wrote last and you haven't answered yet, oldest-waiting first. Skips newsletters, notifications and no-reply senders. Shows whether you already have a draft. Use for "who am I supposed to get back to?", "what's waiting on me?".

account.description: Which mailbox(es): an alias, an email address, a list of them, or "all". Omit to use ALL connected accounts. No accounts connected yet.

olderThanHours.description: Only items waiting at least this long (default 0).
